1.

"What is a man, Lord," That God should take care of him, To reveal to him The secret of His heart? Thou hast revealed God In righteous grace, And obedient unto death Thou hast fulfilled all His counsel.

2.

God’s counsel long before time Prepared Thee, Son of Man, As Head of Thy gathering In light and glory. Now before Thee on the throne In majesty and power, May every knee bow And heed Thy word!

3.

Thou, Son of Man, art worthy Of every crown Thou bearest, Thou art worthy to be acclaimed, Thou art Lord of all. O Lord of the universe, May soon that blessed day, When all acknowledge Thee, Dawn to God’s pleasure!
